rv.q: There’s a considerable amount to admire in this production , but it is ultimately something of a hollow edifice.
Ultimately, The Master Builder succeeds through its compelling performances, above all Binder’s mesmerising and unsettling portrayal of Hilde.

cn.t: Strong central performances anchor this psychologically compelling but slow-burning Ibsen revival, though the unsympathetic characters and befuddling narrative may leave audiences cold.
